verdict.rationale: Warp documents right-click 'Ask Warp AI' to explain any error in command output, demystify opaque error messages and identify missing dependencies, and its agent is pitched to 'debug issues and fix errors'. Independent hands-on reports confirm that Warp proactively surfaced an LLM-suggested fix for a syntax error after a failed test run, via its Prompt Suggestions/Next Command features. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the automatic fix-suggestion flow for failed commands (Active AI/Prompt Suggestions is only evidenced through community reports)
